interpretation_rule: Secondary illustrations only; each architecture is evaluated over the same full rho grid and is not used to establish the primary conclusion.

architectures.label: small_isolated_manual
architectures.construction_rule: low portfolio scale + high attributable share + manual-processing disadvantage + slower living conclusion refresh

architectures.label: shared_balanced
architectures.construction_rule: intermediate portfolio scale, attribution, readiness burden and cadence with processing symmetry

architectures.label: large_automation_assisted
architectures.construction_rule: large shared portfolio + low attributable fraction + automation-favoured processing + short conclusion-refresh interval
